advisories.summary: Opening the Branches panel and pressing Diff with Current can empty one of your files.
advisories.detail: A branch whose name begins with a dash was passed to git as an option instead of as a branch. Git reads --output=<file> as an instruction to write over that file, so the click emptied it. Any file you can write could be hit, and there is no undo. It needs a repository that carries such a branch, so a repository you cloned rather than one you made. 1.1.1 refuses those names and no longer lets a branch name be read as an option.
